reason: A more directly targets full-range adaptive lubrication and extends prior bulk Ag-alloy behavior to a surface intervention on CoCrFeNi, whereas B largely transplants a reported 0.5 at.% W result from an Al-containing BCC coating tested at 800 °C to an FCC CoCrFeNi matrix without sound support for W-rich intermetallics, oxide-glaze formation, or low-temperature friction reduction. A still requires tighter coating-thickness, load, and durability specifications, but its mechanism and controlled comparison are more plausible and meaningfully testable.
